proof.title: Design proof
proof.hint: The final design before cutting. Check names and numbers, colours and where the logos sit; zoom in on the PDF.

signature.title: The document to sign
signature.hint: Read the document in full before you sign it. {company} keeps your signature with this version.

concession.title: Concession
concession.hint: A deviation {company} asks you to accept: what differs, the photos side by side, and what they propose.

sample.hint: The photos and the spec of what {company} asks you to approve. Open a photo full size; mark it to show us a spot.

order.title: Revised order {number} · revision {revision}
order.noLines: No line changed: only the order's details below.
order.netMoved: Your earlier acceptance ends if the net value changes: approving confirms the new total.
order.noPrices: The amounts are not shown here.

files.label: Photos and documents
files.none: No photo or document goes with this request.
files.problem: This file can't be shown right now. You can still answer.

viewer.noPreview: This file can't be shown in the page.

mark.title: Mark the photo: {name}
mark.introPicture: Draw arrows and circles where you want us to look, and add a note. The marks go with your answer when you sign it.
mark.introPdf: Choose the page, draw arrows and circles on it, and add a note. The marks go with your answer when you sign it.
mark.noteHint: What should we look at, or change?
mark.problem: This photo can't be marked right now. Close and try again.

held.none: Draw at least one arrow or circle first.

decision.title: Your decision

APPROVED.title: Approve
APPROVED.body: It is right as it is: go ahead.

APPROVED_WITH_CHANGES.title: Approve with changes
APPROVED_WITH_CHANGES.body: Go ahead once the changes you write below are made.

REFUSED.title: Refuse
REFUSED.body: Do not go ahead: tell us why below.

comment.hint: Anything you want us to know.

decision.markHint: To point at a spot, use Mark the photo on a photo above.
decision.noPhotos: No photo goes with this request.
decision.held: This request takes no answer now.

problem.choose: Choose your answer first: approve, approve with changes or refuse.
problem.long: The comment is too long: at most 4000 characters.

sign.title: Sign your answer

summary.none: Choose your answer above, then type your name to sign it.
summary.APPROVED_WITH_CHANGES: You approve {label} with the changes you wrote.
summary.REFUSED: You refuse {label}, for the reason you wrote.

sign.legal: Your typed name signs this answer; {company} keeps it with the time, the request and what you wrote. You can answer once: this link then opens nothing. We send you a copy by e-mail.
sign.name: Your full name
sign.nameHint: As you sign your letters: first name and surname.
sign.nameEmpty: Type your full name to sign.

done.name: Signed by
done.marksValue: On one photo of the request
done.receiptSent: We sent you a copy by e-mail.
done.receiptFailed: The copy by e-mail did not go out: keep this page as your receipt.
done.closed: This link now opens nothing: the answer is final.

problem.read: The request could not be read.
problem.readBody: Nothing was answered. Check your connection and try again.
problem.gone: This request no longer takes an answer: it was answered, withdrawn or its time ran out.
problem.wrongPerson: This link is for someone else.
problem.changed: The request changed meanwhile: it was read again. Check it and answer again.
problem.name: Type your full name (at least 2 letters) to sign.
problem.invalid: Some of the answer is missing or too long: check the comment and your name.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
problem.unavailable: The service is not answering. Try again in a moment.

office.title: Approve from e-mail
office.checking: Checking whether you are signed in…

signIn.title: Sign in to open the approval
signIn.body: The e-mail approves nothing by itself: sign in to the office as usual, and the approval opens where you decide it.

code.title: The code from your app
code.body: Signing in as {email} needs the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
code.label: Code
code.hint: Paste it or type it: it is checked as soon as it is complete.

open.title: Opening {label}
open.body: The approval opens in the office, where you decide it.

decided.title: This approval no longer waits for you
decided.body: {label} was decided or moved on meanwhile.

notValid.title: This link is not for this account
notValid.body: It opens only for the person it was mailed to, signed in. Everything that waits for you is in Home › Approvals.
notValid.switch: Sign out and use another account

missing.title: There is no approval in this address
missing.body: Open the link from the e-mail again, whole, or sign in and open Home › Approvals.

change.title: Choose a new password first
change.body: Your administrator asked for a new password: set it on the office sign-in, then open the e-mail's link again.

setup.title: Set up two-factor first
setup.body: Your role signs in with a code from an authenticator app. Set it up, then open the e-mail's link again.

error.title: The approval could not be opened.
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

problem.wrongCredentials: The company, e-mail or password is not right (or the account is locked for a while).
problem.wrongCode: That code is not right. Type the current one from your app.
problem.suspended: This account is suspended: ask your administrator.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
problem.invalid: Something in the form is missing or not valid.
problem.unavailable: The service is not answering. Try again in a moment.
